state_model.rule: Quest definitions contain no mutable quest-local state. Every condition and transition reads or writes a typed field in the campaign progression registry.
state_model.excluded_scope_reason: The current runtime has no authoritative party membership, shared checkpoint, lock, recovery, or group-reward service.

schema_definition.transaction_rule: Progression writes and inventory changes in a transition commit atomically for the triggering player. grant_reward_once must durably commit its per-player claim receipt with item delivery. World compare-and-set and actor relocation are idempotent and retryable; they are not represented as one cross-scope transaction.
schema_definition.progression_registration_rule: Every progression_field_refs id must be declared exactly once in data/progression.json quest_fields. That registry is authoritative for type, scope, initial value, and allowed values.
schema_definition.mixed_scope_rule: A mixed quest declares scope per progression field. World effects use an idempotent compare-and-set transition; rewards and dialogue cursors remain per player.

physical_evidence.description: Pallet's constructed road and settled soil meet a foreign northbound trail, wrong skyline, and unfamiliar surrounding geography.
physical_evidence.runtime_evidence_check: The proven schema has no coordinate or object-inspection predicate; Mina's dialogue is the simplest compilable version.

physical_evidence.description: Three localized damaged homes show that the exchange boundary closed badly without making optional rescue content carry the main reveal.
A labeled sample pairs native plateau shale directly against Pallet soil with no intervening layer; it makes Brock's claim inspectable without inventing new terrain.
A relief ledger and a compact group of ordinary belongings make the rescued families concrete without assigning a named faction arc.
A waveform or timestamp record shows repeated timing and direction corrections; the array supplies the measured source.
A tangible ledger on a lectern compares the former descending channel profile and settled western summit with the present impossible dry channel from (3786, 1182) to (3376, 921).
Successive destination marks visibly drift; one control plate carries the Hoopa ring symbol and name.
Water, glacier, memory, Pokemon-behavior, and signal records share aligned activation peaks; the table corroborates Sabrina without pretending to record Hoopa's thoughts.
The model visibly marks roads, homes, heat, and moving life; an attached acknowledgment shows leadership received the warning before ordering the activation.
A route packet supports the claim that loyalists are moving to the Rift and that dissenters supplied an approach, without introducing a named faction character arc.
Straight scars, displaced material, and worsening effects along the Rift provide the final environmental exposition.
